newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH VISCOPLAST IPO SEEN OVERSUBSCRIBED.
newsitem.headline: POLISH VISCOPLAST IPO SEEN OVERSUBSCRIBED.

text.p: Polish chemical company Viscoplast SA's 900,000-share initial public offering is likely to be oversubscribed, the president of the firm said on Thursday.
"Initially one can say the issue was successful, there is a large oversubscription in both tranches," Adam Nowotarski told Reuters.
Nowotarski said full data on the subscription is likely to be available on Tuesday next week.
Viscoplast's shares were priced at 14 zlotys each. The company has estimated its 1996 net profit was 1.8 million zlotys on 36-million-zloty sales.
